item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Esha must construct a $55^{\circ}$ angle with ruler and protractor. The diagram shows vertex $V$ and base arm $VA$ already drawn.

Which plan correctly builds that angle?

options.A: Seat the protractor centre on $V$, align arm $VA$ with $0^{\circ}$, mark $55^{\circ}$ on the correct scale, and draw the second arm through that mark.
options.B: Call the finished drawing the vertex and stop there.
options.C: Seat the protractor centre on $V$ but leave arm $VA$ off the $0^{\circ}$ mark before marking $55^{\circ}$.
options.D: Mark $55$ only because that number is printed in the stem.
